header.running_head: How the Ansaar Severed the Ties they had During the Period of Ignorance to Strengthen the Ties of Islaam

blocks.text:
According to a narration of Hadhrat Urwa (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ praised Allaah when they reported back to him. A narration of Ibn Sa'd states that (after killing Ka'b) when Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) and his companions reached Baqee Gharqad (the graveyard), they shouted "Allaahu Akbar!". Rasulullaah ﷺ was busy performing salaah that night and when he heard them shout "Allaahu Akbar!", he also shouted "Allaahu Akbar!" because he guessed that they had already killed Ka'b. When they came to him, Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "(You have the) Faces of successful people." "Your face is too, O Rasulullaah ﷺ," they responded. They then threw Ka'b's head before Rasulullaah ﷺ and he praised Allaah for Ka'b's death.
A narration of Hadhrat Ikrama states that (after Ka'b's death) the Jews became terrified and came to Rasulullaah ﷺ. They said, "Our leader was killed by deception." Rasulullaah ﷺ reminded them of Ka'b's treacherous ways and about how he instigated against Islaam and harmed the Muslims. Ibn Sa'd adds that after this, the Jews became scared and kept silent. [^1]

Ibn Is'haaq narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once announced, "Who will see to Ibn Ashraf for me?" Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) said, "I shall see to him for you, O Rasulullaah ﷺ. I shall kill him." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Do so if you can." Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) spent the next three days without eating or drinking anything besides what was needed to preserve his life. When Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed about this, he called Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) and asked him why he had stopped eating and drinking. He replied, "I have promised you something that I am unsure whether I will be able to fulfil." Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "All you have to do is to try."
Another narration of Ibn Is'haaq from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) states that Rasulullaah ﷺ even walked with Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) and his companions up to Baqee Gharqad and pointed them in the direction saying, "Proceed with the name of Allaah. O Allaah! Assist them." [^2]
Abu Raafi Sallaam bin Abul Huqayq is Killed

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ka'b bin Maalik (RA)
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ka'b bin Maalik (RA) says that amongst the many advantages that Allaah had granted Rasulullaah ﷺ (to facilitate the effective propagation of Deen) was that the two (Ansaar) tribes of the Khazraj and Aws were always competing to serve Rasulullaah ﷺ just as two wrestlers compete. Whenever the Aws did something to benefit Rasulullaah ﷺ, the Khazraj would say, "By Allaah! By doing this you shall not surpass our standing with Rasulullaah ﷺ." They would then stop at nothing to match the feat. Similarly, whenever the Khazraj did something to win Rasulullaah ﷺ's favour, the Aws would say the same thing.
